decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered CHR102.ESE.W4, CHR102.EFS.W4, CHR102.ESAA.W4, CHR.PFRE.W4, CHR102.PSE.W4,Received 7 March 2012 , CHR102.EFS.W4, Received 2 May 2012  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The future occupiers of the units hereby approved shall not be permitted to apply for a residential parking permit, or visitors parking permit.

Condition : 5 - The obscure glazed fencing shall be erected around the rooflights on the roof of 100 Chiswick High Road as shown on the plan number CHR102.EFS.W4, prior to the occupation of the new residential units.
description: Conversion of existing office and residential space at first and second floor into four flats of which three are 2 bed and one is 1-bed with rear landscaped area to first floor
